title: Camper Wood Stove Experiment Pt 2:  First Test in my Outback Trailer
description:
In my second video on installing a wood stove in my Outback fiberglass camper, I fire it up to see if there are any issues before I take it on the next winter campout. 

DISCLAIMER: Wood stoves can be very dangerous. Do not try to replicate this. For entertainment purposes only!
